_about: Known prices of the tariff year NOVA currently holds, used by tools/nova-import/derive.ts to validate the price ladders it derives. Networks with a grid under packages/engine/data/tariffs/networks/ are compared with that grid (its `previous` block, or the grid itself when its `year` is the ladder's year); this file is for networks whose grid lives elsewhere.

mobilis.source: packages/engine/data/nova/COMPARISON.md (b): prices quoted by sbb.ch on 10.11.2026 for validity in 2026 (7, 9, 10 zones, all zones), and the 3- and 4-zone prices, unchanged in the grid valid from 13.12.2026
